releases.name: v6.0.0
releases.body:
The first release for Freelens 2.0. The extension now uses the v2 extension API, so it needs Freelens 2.0.0 or later. With Freelens 1.x, keep using a 5.x release.

## Requirements

- Freelens >= 2.0.0
- Flux >= v2.0.0, <= 2.9.x
- flux-operator >= v0.6.0, for the `fluxcd.controlplane.io` kinds
- source-watcher >= v2.0.0, for `ArtifactGenerator` (optional)

## Install or upgrade

In Freelens 2.0, open Extensions, enter `@freelensapp/fluxcd-extension` and press Install. You can also install the `.tgz` of this release by its URL: Freelens checks it against the `.tgz.sha256` next to it.

## New

- **ExternalArtifact** (`source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1`): a page in the Source group, details with the source and the artifact, and a chart on the Overview. A Kustomization or HelmRelease that uses one as its source links to it.
- **ArtifactGenerator** (`source.extensions.fluxcd.io/v1beta1`, source-watcher): a page, details, a chart on the Overview, and the Reconcile and Suspend/Resume menu items.
- **ImagePolicy**: the details show Resumed, Interval, Digest Reflection Policy, and the latest and previous image references. ImagePolicy `v1` and `v1beta2` get the Suspend/Resume menu item.
- **One sidebar entry per Flux kind**: while the extension is enabled, the Flux kinds are no longer listed a second time in the Custom Resources tree of the cluster sidebar, only under "FluxCD".

## Fixed

- **Overview charts**: each object is counted in one category. A suspended object without conditions no longer makes "In progress" negative. The Flux Operator kinds and `ArtifactGenerator` show as suspended when their reconcile annotation is `disabled`.
- **Condition badges**: a stalled object shows as an error, a suspended one as Suspended. Sorting the conditions no longer reorders them in the object itself.
- **Links in the details**: references whose field implies the kind now link to the object, opened at the newest API version the cluster serves:
  - `dependsOn` of a Kustomization or HelmRelease;
  - `providerRef` of an Alert;
  - `imageRepositoryRef` of an ImagePolicy;
  - the included repositories of a GitRepository.
- **Render errors**: an error in a page, details panel or menu item of the extension stays in its place, as an error message or a missing menu item. It no longer replaces the whole cluster view. This also fixes a crash in the details of an ImageRepository `v1beta2` without latest tags.
- **Optional fields**: the model types follow the kubebuilder markers of the Flux APIs, so a panel no longer fails on a field that the API does not require.

## What's Changed

- Migrate to the Freelens v2 extension API in #297
- Replace moment with the date helpers of the host in #312
- Count each object of the Overview chart in one category in #313
- Fix the condition badges of stalled and suspended objects and sort a copy of the conditions in #316
- Add suspend, interval, digestReflectionPolicy and latestRef to ImagePolicy in #317
- Link references in the details that imply their kind in #318
- Register the models with pages in customResources in #321
- Add ExternalArtifact in #323
- Add ArtifactGenerator in #325
- Register details and menu items with the typed helpers of the extension API in #328
- Take the optional fields of the model types from the kubebuilder markers in #329
- Keep a render error of the extension inside its page, panel or menu item in #331
- Run the integration tests against Freelens dev over CDP in #339

The rest are dependency updates and changes to the build and the workflows, which follow freelensapp/freelens-example-extension (#332, #335).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/freelensapp/freelens-fluxcd-extension/compare/v5.3.1...v6.0.0
